description: Makes a look for Ordkort and returns a link that shows it and applies it if the person agrees. Read design_guide first. front_html and back_html are card templates with fields in double braces: {{term}}, {{translation}}, {{pronunciation}}, {{grammar}}, {{forms}}, {{example}}, {{example_translation}}, {{image}}, {{audio}}, {{deck}}; {{#example}}…{{/example}} shows its inside only when the card has an example. The card's picture: or var(--card-image) in CSS. Pictures by https address (CSS url() or ) are fetched once by Ordkort, at most 8. card_css styles the cards, site_css the whole site through CSS variables (--paper, --card, --ink, --blue, --font-serif…). Scripts and event handlers are removed. The answer may carry notes on what will not work as meant.
name: create_design
title: Make a look for cards
